search_window.basis: Since the completed_at of the preceding verified Food Line supplementary heartbeat; seek newly published or newly effective U.S. food-access interruptions.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall, not a nationwide primary collection. Production collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting a community's only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended owing to storm, flood, fire, power outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank service closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.search_engine: web fast; recency=1 day; Nov 9, 2026 targeted search terms; screened original event and publication dates

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Exclude donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, inflation-only stories, historical incidents, duplicates and non-U.S. events.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption independently verified for the hourly window. Twelve targeted searches usable; six of eight direct pages accessible. Two inaccessible direct endpoints limit corroboration but do not materially defeat the narrow supplementary recall; lack of findings does not prove nationwide absence.
